title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن في قناة الجزيرة مباشر
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan on Al Jazeera Mubasher
body_ar: استضافت قناة الجزيرة الفضائية أمس الجمعة في الساعة السادسة مساءا فضيلة العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في برنامج "مباشر مع" في موضوع حول: "دور العلماء في مواجهة الفتن". وقد أبرز فضيلة العلامة ما للعلماء من دور فعال ومسؤولية جسيمة اتجاه ما يحدث في العالم الإسلامي من الفتن الطائفية والسياسية. وأكد فضيلته على أن العلماء هم ورثة الأنبياء، وخلفاء الله في الأرض، يجب عليهم أن يقوموا بواجبهم، ولا تأخذهم في الله لومة لائم؛ ينصروا المظلوم، ويأخذوا على يد الظالم، ويقفوا في وجه كل شرارة بادئة للفتن. وبين – حفظه الله- أن تبليغ الإسلام فريضة، وهو الدور المنوط بالعلماء أساسا، ومن ذلك تبين سماحته ووسطيته للناس. ونشير إلى أن البرنامج تخللته اتصالات؛ تطرح أسئلة على الشيخ وتضيف مداخلات، رد الشيخ على معظمها ردودا وافية، وضاق الوقت عن بعضها.
body_en: Al Jazeera satellite channel hosted his eminence the erudite Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew yesterday, Friday, at six in the evening, on the programme "Live With", on a subject concerning "The Role of the Scholars in Confronting Strife". His eminence brought out the effective role and the grave responsibility that the scholars bear towards what is taking place in the Muslim world of sectarian and political strife (fitan). His eminence affirmed that the scholars are the heirs of the prophets and God's successors on earth; that they are obliged to discharge their duty and to let no reproacher's reproach deter them where God is concerned; that they should aid the wronged, restrain the hand of the wrongdoer, and stand in the face of every first spark of strife. He explained — may God preserve him — that conveying Islam is an obligation (farīḍah), and that this is the role entrusted to the scholars first and foremost, part of which is to make its tolerance and its balance plain to people. We note that the programme was interspersed with calls putting questions to the Sheikh and adding contributions, most of which the Sheikh answered fully, while time ran short for some of them.

flags.note: The CMS dates this record Sunday 9 January 2011, but the text says the broadcast was 'yesterday, Friday'. Sunday's yesterday is Saturday, so the two cannot both be right. This is direct internal evidence that the CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date rather than the date of composition. The date must not be presented to readers as the date of the broadcast.

flags.note: The only ruling term in the record, and it reaches us at second hand — it is the site editor's summary of a live broadcast, not the Sheikh's written words. Rendered as 'an obligation (farīḍah)' per the fixed mapping, but it should not be cited as a written fatwa of the Sheikh.

flags.context: الفتن الطائفية والسياسية / كل شرارة بادئة للفتن
flags.note: fitnah spans civil discord, sectarian conflict and religious trial. The context here (sectarian and political, with 'the first spark') is civil strife, so 'strife' is used throughout. Not in the glossary; worth adding.

translator_notes: A site news notice summarising a live television appearance, not a text by the Sheikh. The reporting frame is preserved in every sentence so that nothing reads as his own written words.
'ولا تأخذهم في الله لومة لائم' echoes the Qur'anic phrase at Sūrat al-Māʾidah 5:54. The Sheikh (as reported) does not present it as a citation, so no reference has been added to the English.
'مساءا' is written with a final alif where 'مساءً' is standard; left as served.
